---
title: "Analyse Case Study: Orben 2019 (NHB)"
format: pdf
---

```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

This document analyses the three multiverse datasets from Orben & Przybylski (2019, *Nature Human Behaviour*): MCS Total, MTF, and YRBS.
The outcome metric used throughout is the regression effect size (`effect`).
`mv_dim_y_variable` is used as-is (a single comma-separated categorical decision) for `decide()`, but expanded into per-variable binary indicator columns (via `expand_y_variable()`) for regression and FANOVA: `lm()` needs a numeric design matrix, and FANOVA errors out on the raw categorical with thousands of unique levels. Expanded importances are collapsed back to a single `mv_dim_y_variable` entry via `aggregate_onehot_importances()`.

---

# Overview

## Load Data

```{r yrbs-load-data}
mv_yrbs_org <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_yrbs")
mv_yrbs_onehot <- mv_yrbs_org |>
  expand_y_variable()
mv_yrbs <- mv_yrbs_org
mv_yrbs
```

```{r mtf-load-data}
mv_mtf_org <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_mtf")
mv_mtf_onehot <- mv_mtf_org |>
  expand_y_variable()
mv_mtf <- mv_mtf_org
mv_mtf
```

```{r mcs-load-data}
mv_mcs_org <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_mcs_total")
mv_mcs_onehot <- mv_mcs_org |>
  expand_y_variable()
mv_mcs <- mv_mcs_org
mv_mcs
```

## Multiverse Overview / Descriptives

Note: Even though MCS has only ~ 20,000 rows this is a subsample (for practical, computational reasons) of a much larger potential multiverse.

```{r}
tibble(
  multiverse = c(
    "YRBS", "MTF", "MCS"
  ),
  mv_size = c(
    mv_yrbs |> 
      nrow(),
    mv_mtf |> 
      nrow(),
    mv_mcs |> 
      nrow()
  ),
  n_decisions_org = c(
    mv_yrbs_org |>
      get_multiverse_decisions() |>
      length(),
    mv_mtf_org |>
      get_multiverse_decisions() |>
      length(),
    mv_mcs_org |>
      get_multiverse_decisions() |>
      length()
  ),
  n_decisions_onehot = c(
    mv_yrbs_onehot |>
      get_multiverse_decisions() |>
      length(),
    mv_mtf_onehot |>
      get_multiverse_decisions() |>
      length(),
    mv_mcs_onehot |>
      get_multiverse_decisions() |>
      length()
  )
)
```

### YRBS

```{r yrbs-decisions-overview}
mv_yrbs |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```

```{r yrbs-multiverse-simple}
#| fig-width: 10
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_yrbs, direction = "right")
```

### MTF

```{r mtf-decisions-overview}
mv_mtf |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```

```{r mtf-multiverse-simple}
#| fig-width: 10
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_mtf, direction = "right")
```

### MCS

```{r mcs-decisions-overview}
mv_mcs |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```

```{r mcs-multiverse-simple}
#| fig-width: 10
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_mcs, direction = "right")
```

# YRBS

## Existing Methods

### Regression

```{r yrbs-regression-fit}
reg_yrbs <- calc_regression(mv_yrbs_onehot, colname_metric = "effect")
attr(reg_yrbs, "tidy")
```

#### Performance

```{r yrbs-regression-performance}
reg_yrbs |>
  model_performance()
```

#### Model Fit

```{r yrbs-regression-model-check}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 12
reg_yrbs |>
  check_model()
```

```{r yrbs-regression-pred-check}
reg_yrbs |>
  check_predictions()
```

```{r yrbs-regression-residuals-fitted}
vis_residuals_vs_fitted(reg_yrbs)
```

```{r yrbs-regression-observed-predicted}
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_yrbs)
```

```{r yrbs-regression-observed-predicted-kde}
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_yrbs, type = "kde")
```

```{r yrbs-regression-observed-predicted-hist-overlapping}
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_yrbs, type = "hist")
```

```{r yrbs-regression-observed-predicted-hist}
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 7
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_yrbs, type = "hist", facet = T)
```

```{r yrbs-regression-coefficients}
vis_regression_coefficients(reg_yrbs)
```

#### Importance

```{r yrbs-regression-importance}
regimp_yrbs <- calc_regression_importance(mv_yrbs_onehot, colname_metric = "effect") |>
  aggregate_onehot_importances()
regimp_yrbs
```

```{r yrbs-regression-importance-plot}
vis_importance(regimp_yrbs)
```

### FANOVA

```{r yrbs-fanova-fit}
fanova_yrbs <- calc_fanova(mv_yrbs_onehot, colname_metric = "effect", use_individual = TRUE)
fanova_yrbs
```

```{r yrbs-fanova-importance-plot}
fanova_yrbs |>
  fanova_to_vec() |>
  aggregate_onehot_importances() |>
  sort(decreasing = TRUE) |>
  head(10) |>
  vis_importance()
```

## Our Framework

```{r yrbs-decide}
decide_yrbs <- decide(mv_yrbs, colname_metric = "effect")
decide_yrbs
```

```{r yrbs-decide-plot}
decide_vec_yrbs <- decide_vec(mv_yrbs, colname_metric = "effect")
vis_importance(decide_vec_yrbs)
```

### Combine

```{r yrbs-combine-importance}
vis_importance_2dim(
  decide_vec_yrbs,
  fanova_yrbs |> fanova_to_vec() |> aggregate_onehot_importances()
)
```

### Composite importance table

```{r yrbs-importance-composite}
compose_importance_table(
  decide = decide_yrbs,
  fanova_main = calc_fanova_main_importance(mv_yrbs_onehot, colname_metric = "effect") |> aggregate_onehot_importances(),
  regression = regimp_yrbs,
  caption = "Importance estimates per decision, by method (Orben 2019, YRBS).",
  label = "importance-yrbs"
)
```
